lines.en: I hop along with a heavy pack
My umbrella leaf sways behind me

lines.zh: 我跳过一块石头，差点摔
lines.en: I hop a stone and nearly tumble
My boots are caked with mud
I take the path; I know it well
I wind my way through the woods
Something rattles in my pack
I stop and take two breaths
I head toward the woodsmoke
My prints are small and round
I shift the pack to the other shoulder
I slip my way across the stream
I sit on my pack to rest
I open the leaf umbrella and fold it
I count today's stock
I look up at the trees and think about the road
My throat swells once
I'm here for customers
Wind lifts my cloak
I rub my two hands together
Good sun for travelling
My hat brim sits low
I smooth out a cloth
I croak a little tune
I check the sky
This tent is well pitched
My wares mustn't get damp
This will do for today
I plan to head south tomorrow
I lean the leaf on my shoulder
A customer at last
Take a look; all good goods
I don't take strange payment
I know what you're holding
Squat down to talk to me
My stall is right here
Would you like a map
You won't find my wares elsewhere
You've come far; tired?
Look first; buying is optional
I have umbrella leaves too
You're blocking my light here
I hug my pack and back away
My hat rolled into the mud water
I crouch and cover my head
I stay quiet and just want to leave
The leaf takes some of it
I hop two paces and land hard
My wares are scattered everywhere
I pant, my throat working

lines.zh: 这一下打在做买卖的人身上
lines.en: That blow landed on a trader
I haul myself up by the stall
Amethyst? Good stuff
You crouch, and I know what that means
Let me see the quality
This could buy half my cart
Are you willing to part with it
I want more of these
Good quality; we have a deal
Don't set it on the ground; it'll dirty
This is my favorite sort of thing
Try another piece
You bump me and my pack tilts
I open the leaf to catch the shove
My goods spill everywhere
I crouch at once to gather them

lines.zh: 你从我脑袋上跨了过去
lines.en: You stepped right over my head

lines.zh: 我们一起撞在帐篷杆上
lines.en: We both hit the tent pole
I step back and straighten my hat
That wasn't a bump, just a squeeze
Mind the pack on my back
A corner of my leaf is creased

lines.zh: 另一个背包从林子里过来
lines.en: Another pack comes out of the woods
We set our stalls side by side
She sells much what I do
We count stock together
Her umbrella leaf is newer than mine
We split a piece of bread
She says north next year
We trade maps
She hops a little higher than I
It's good to have company on the road
I pick it up carefully
This will fetch a good price
I blow the dirt off
It's heavy; into the pack it goes
I hold it to the light
I won't take this one
I count and I'm one short
The quality is only so-so
I wrap it up carefully
I'll keep this one for myself

lines.zh: 你看着我的货，眼神不对
lines.en: You're eyeing my wares oddly
I rise from my pack
I don't like being surrounded
I shift the pack behind me
These parts aren't safe
My umbrella leaf is open
Come closer and I'll leave
I've seen that look plenty
If you're not buying, move along
I'm packing up
I retreat behind the tent
I tuck the valuables into an inner pocket

lines.zh: 我的眼一直粘着你的手
lines.en: My eye stays stuck to your hands
I drift toward the trees
I know this path better than you
I won't call for help
I hold the leaf in front of me
Don't touch my pack

lines.zh: 我的伞叶举着，你别靠太近。
lines.en: My parasol leaf is raised; do not come too close.
I'll count to three and go
I swat your hand with the leaf
I kick your knee

lines.zh: 这一下我只想让你退开
lines.en: I only wanted you to back off

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的袖子上
lines.en: I clamp my teeth on your sleeve
You back two steps and I stop
I swing the pack at you

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，我自己差点倒
lines.en: I miss and nearly fall myself
I butt my head into your waist
You raise a hand and I hop away
Don't push a trader
A small tent goes up in the woods
I lay the goods out one by one
My umbrella leaf comes out of the brush first
I'll rest my feet here
A croak, and then me
My pack is bigger than I am
I'm a familiar sight on this road
I take my hat off to fan myself

lines.zh: 林子里的空地刚好摆摊
lines.en: This clearing suits a stall
I count what's left
Fresh footprints; someone's near
I'll stay here a couple of days
I roll into the mud with my pack

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，包先着地
lines.en: I fall from the tree, pack first

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，我叫不出
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I can't croak
The blast scatters my stall
An arrow passes through my cloak

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的腿发软
lines.en: That force turns my legs to jelly
Three days on the road; only cloth in the pack

lines.zh: 雷劈在帐篷杆上，我缩成一团
lines.en: Lightning hits the pole and I curl up

lines.zh: 脚下没有路，我抓不住包
lines.en: No road below; I can't hold my pack
